profile.headline: Software Developer
profile.summary:
As a hands-on professional and concept-to-execution driver with a Bachelor's Software Engineering degree from The University of Texas at Dallas, I am offering progressive experience in software development and system administration; backed by solid expertise in handling various software projects from inception to completion and delivery. 

I am known for proven adeptness in defining technical requirements; overseeing operational strategies; resolving complex issues; and coordinating team efforts toward operational efficiency, process improvement, customer satisfaction, and company growth. I possess strong capability to develop and implement key IT initiatives and cost-reduction strategies to drive continuous performance and process improvement.

Furthermore, I possess exceptional ability to identify and create technology-based solutions to address software problems while ensuring organizational efficiency and productivity.

positions.title: Associate Software Developer
positions.description:
Key role as a developer support with responsibility of troubleshooting issues in the system through SQL Server Management Studio, Visual Studio 2019, VS Code, Chrome tools and other integrated development environments (IDE) to conduct analysis of SQL, C#, and VB.Net code as well as to determine the cause of the issue while creating a script using T-SQL to resolve the problem 
Identification issue as well as preparation and submission of detailed document with explanation of the cause, relevant code, UI pages, scripts, and steps to replicate or determine the issues within the front-end
Accountability in writing scripts for updating, deleting, and entering data to the system or database and other scripts to support access to one-time and up-to-date reports in the system by all users
Application of technical proficiency in utilizing Salesforce in communicating with the requester; Azure in storing code repositories; as well as Microsoft teams to facilitate team communications 
Administration of delegated tickets and obtainment of consistent ranking as top 2 or 3 for each week in a team of nine 
Recipient of remarkable recognition from assigned mentor for completing given tasks with little to no support

positions.title: SQL Financial Analyst
positions.description:
Thorough evaluation of database objects for potential optimizations
Full control of a reporting database in establishing procedures that included execution of extract, transform, load (ETL) procedure from a transactional database
Fulfillment of key assignments including assessment, , resolving, testing, and initiating T-SQL code as well as writing T-SQL scripts for ad-hoc reports
Close interaction with other teams in completing a task
Responsibility in coaching teammate in T-SQL, its strategies, proper syntax styles, tips and tricks for better performing queries, and overall use of the language.
Integral role in optimizing slow-running stored procedures

positions.title: SQL Developer
positions.description:
Utilization of Atlassian products such as Jira Service Desk, Confluence/wiki, Bit bucket, and OpsGenie as well as Git version control, Trello, and Microsoft products
Development and amendment of stored procedures for consuming files of different formats including pdf, xls, xlsx, csv, and txt; for files, web reports, and business logic development; as well as for user authentication and system functionality
Documentation of accomplished tasks and coordination with requestors, specifiers, and clients

company.name: The National Math and Science Initiative

positions.title: SQL Developer
positions.description:
Active involvement in handling and accomplishing Visual Studio Team Foundation Server (TFS) database project as well as in managing structure and SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) maintenance throughout the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)
Application of industry expertise in creating various technological solutions such as:
-T-SQL views and queries for Power BI reporting;
-New SQL database as a service in Azure along with tables, relationships, views, and user accounts for a new research project;
-Tables, functions, views, stored procedures, and other database objects through T-SQL for requests and projects in accordance with a scrum framework; and
-SSIS packages and T-SQL jobs in regulating business processes, reporting, and exports and imports
Utilization of T-SQL in drafting and submitting reports for the business as well as C# in SSIS with Script Task and Smartsheet application programming interface (API) in syncing an Excel spreadsheet stored in SharePoint with SmartSheet
Development of solution for any data issues and discrepancies while upholding data integrity through the use of SQL Server Management Studio
Formulation of all database objects through SSMS and database projects in TFS
Expert management of timelines and expectations for projects, requests, and incidents by monitoring in Visual Studio Team Services (VSTS)
Pivotal role in defining and driving automation and reporting opportunities while creating effective solutions to maximize business productivity
Delivery of support to .NET Development Team with regard to code changes in compliance with continuous integration and continuous delivery with SOLID principles
Driving force behind the improvement of executions and load from 50% to 75% on multiple database objects  through initiation of execution plan analysis

positions.title: Systems Support
positions.description:
Establishment and strengthening of long-term business relationship with IT vendors 
Assessment of problem data to fully understand all support problems and offer appropriate solutions
Organization of problem documentations and resolution procedures for reference procedures
Adherence to standard operating procedures as well as service level agreements.
Performance of applications, hardware, and software installation, configuration, and administration, such as Office 365 
Accountability in setting up accounts, personal computers, and workstations for new employees
Endowment of assistance in designing and improving IT systems
Organization and facilitation of IT-related trainings to new hires, users, and technical teams
Institution of employee termination procedures from all systems
Delivery of on-time and precise customer support tickets, thereby obtaining 98% customer satisfaction rating at the end of the year with more than 200 tickets

positions.title: .Net Developer Intern
positions.description:
Proper handling of DotNetNuke tickets and user interface (UI) tickets for code changes
Keen monitoring and assessment of senior developers in creating applications
Strict compliance with strict process of change approval and release
Accomplishment of set-forth learning path by the chief information officer

educations.schoolName: The University of Texas at Dallas

courses.name: Build A Blog Using AspNet Core, Angular 11 And SQL Server

projects.title: Artist Web Application
projects.description:
Generation of design for the following: 
- A single-page web application for an artist friend through Angular framework;
-  Components, interceptors, services, directives, route modules, observables, reactive, and template-driven forms, pipes, and auth guards to present multiple options as admin and other Angular objects; and
- Web application through Google’s Firebase hosting and VS Code as IDE, as well as BitBucket as the source control and Auth.0 in authenticating users using Facebook, Gmail, or by creating a user account
Employment skills in using HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, Angular Material, RxJs, JavaScript, draw.io, and TypeScript in constructing the application
Administration and completion of T-SQL/SQL Server database backend and .Net core API project
Enablement of easy manipulation, adding, or deleting of items as well as viewing of orders, messages, and comments for site administrator, while ensuring rapid browsing of the artwork, selecting different options for the art piece, and submitting orders, messages, and comments of all site visitors

projects.title: Blog Lab Web Application
projects.description:
Construction of a full stack blogging web application with Angular, Bootstrap, .Net Core, SQL Server, and BitBucket
Active engagement in the entire build process, from the very beginning stages of planning and moving ahead to solutions implementation
